data.title: 卡芙卡 · 匹诺康尼丝绒小憩
data.description: 【卡芙卡 · 匹诺康尼丝绒小憩】梦之国度匹诺康尼豪华酒店顶层套房中，复古留声机低吟着爵士乐。卡芙卡慵懒斜倚在墨绿色复古丝绒沙发上，交叠着修长白皙的高开叉美腿，指尖摇曳着香槟杯，眼神迷离而充满玩味——「在这场永不落幕的美梦里……你想要和我一起，做些什么呢？」

data.promptProse: Kafka reclines on the antique green velvet sofa in the Penacony suite, legs crossed beneath her plum evening gown and champagne glass gently lifted in a gloved hand. A gramophone sits beside the sofa in the eye-level medium view, with full-height windows behind. Dim chandelier warmth reveals the velvet pile and gold jewelry, while dream-city neon colors reflect on the glass and the gown's shadowed folds.
